Standard: 1.P.EICC.1.e

Domain secondary: Writing, Comprehension
Competency: Participate actively in a community of readers and writers by following group norms, discussing texts, sharing writing, listening to others, and giving and receiving feedback.

- comprehension_response: Listen attentively to others' writing and participate in text discussions

Standard: 1.P.EICC.4.e
Domain primary: Writing
Competency: Create an initial draft by combining ideas and information, choosing appropriate words and sentences, and using writing techniques to effectively achieve the text's purpose and connect with the intended audience.
Official text: Construct an initial draft by integrating ideas and information; selecting words, phrases, and sentences; and incorporating craft techniques that will best achieve the purpose of the text and resonate with the target audience. (C)

- Integrate ideas and information to construct an initial draft.
- Select words, phrases, and sentences to include in the draft.
- Incorporate craft techniques to enhance the draft's effectiveness.
- Ensure the draft achieves the purpose of the text and resonates with the target audience.

- Combine ideas and information to form a draft.
- Select words, phrases, and sentences that fit the purpose of the text.
- Use writing techniques or craft elements to enhance the draft.

- procedural_application: Apply writing processes to plan and compose a draft that fits the purpose and audience.
- reasoning_explanation: Explain how chosen words, phrases, and craft techniques help achieve the text's purpose and connect with the audience.

- reasoning_explanation: Explain how the introduction, facts, and closure help shape understanding of the topic.
